doc.description:
Compute the dropping point for a fixedwing aircraft. Takes into account the flight speed vector and the wind to estimate the best dropping point. Needs some waypoints to be defined in the flight plan: REALEASE, CLIMB, BASELEG
With NAV_DROP_USE_AGL_DIST (agl_dist module) nav_drop_update_release() takes the fall height from the rangefinder while it is in range, for releases a few metres above ground.

define.name: TRIGGER_DELAY
define.description: time from the release command to the payload leaving, s

define.name: SAFE_CLIMB
define.description: climb-out height above the release altitude, m

define.name: NAV_DROP_USE_AGL_DIST
define.description: use agl_dist for the fall height when valid

define.name: NAV_DROP_RELEASE_WITH_DELAY
define.description: RELEASE includes the TRIGGER_DELAY travel; fly to it with approaching_time 0
